description: Windah Basudara's clean-streamer seal breaks: six racing meltdowns with raw swearing in GTA VI. Source = .cache/wizzclip/windah-gtavi-segel/source.mp4 (also Drive clip-src/windah-gtavi-segel.mp4): seven pieces (0.6 s padding each) of the stream #6 hour files in output order (windah-live6/stream-1315-1415.mp4 = h1, stream-1415-1515.mp4 = hA, stream-1452-1515.mp4 = hB), 1080p30 re-encoded and joined. Cuts: T t 404.20-405.70 = local 0.60-2.10 -> output 0.00-1.50; K1 t 2583.40-2586.00 = local 3.30-5.90 -> output 1.50-4.10; K2 t 2785.60-2788.40 = local 7.10-9.90 -> output 4.10-6.90; K3 t 580.20-583.10 = local 11.10-14.00 -> output 6.90-9.80; K4 t 1500.40-1508.30 = local 15.20-23.10 -> output 9.80-17.70; K5 t 404.00-408.30 = local 24.30-28.60 -> output 17.70-22.00; K6 t 431.50-434.45 = local 29.80-32.75 -> output 22.00-24.95. Rage compilation, swears RAW in audio and subtitles (user's explicit decision, 22 Nov 2026; breaks the MotionKlip no-swears rule, every other rule kept). Frame-0 teaser = hB 6:44 'ganjelan memek' (1.5 s), then stream order: h1 43:03 'anjir, laju banget itu orang', h1 46:26 'diinjak gua anjing' (truck jumps over his bike), hA 9:41 'anjing, eh ulang' after a crash, hA 25:00 'ngentot... ngentot gaming, anjing, NPC-NPC ini anjing' (bots ramming him at night), hB 6:44 'ganjelan memek, emang itu jam tangan rolek memek?' (wall hit, 4th to 9th of 16), hB 7:11 'rolek anjing, logo rolek, babi emg' (pile-up). Word timings from faster-whisper medium with VAD on short windows. CUT: in-game Lucia 'Huh, I always wondered what it was like to suck at this' (hB 7:15, also below the game crop) and Jason's 'fuck you too, sweetie' (hB 7:18.9), hB 7:01.1 'gimak anjing' (over the start grid), hA 25:11 repeat. 'rolek' is a watch brand named in passing by Windah (no platform). Pause menus in K3 show only 'Restart Race / Quit Race'. No guns, gore, bikini, gambling or self-promo in these frames. Main 24.95 s + 4.0 s outro. Short format (user, 19 Nov: clips 45-60 s lost viewers at ~10 s, so aim for 20-30 s, payoff first). Facecam-below layout (windah_recipe.py layout 'face'): gameplay = source crop 1504x846 at (0,0) scaled to 1080x608 at y364 (the corner facecam is outside the crop, no blur), Windah's facecam = source crop 400x300 at (1520,552) scaled to 520x390 in a 4 px Volt frame, centred at x276, y994-1392, clear of TikTok's bottom caption area and right icon column; hook line 1 Paper 'SEGELNYA WINDAH', line 2 Volt 'KEBUKA', Audex 68, bottom-anchored at y318; credit tag y326; subs at y905 over the lower gameplay panel. Word timings from faster-whisper medium on boosted audio. Cuts on input 0 stay in source order; an earlier-shown later moment has its own seeked input.
